newsitem.title: USA: Grubb sells stake to Goldman Sachs unit.
newsitem.headline: Grubb sells stake to Goldman Sachs unit.

text.p: Grubb & Ellis Co said it sold 2.5 million shares of common stock, equal to about an 11 percent stake in the company, for $11.25 million to Archon Group LP, a majority-owned unit of Goldman Sachs.

The $11.25 million, together with existing cash, will be used to exercise an option to purchase, and retire, Grubb & Ellis' remaining debt of $15 million face amount senior notes, at $13 million plus interest. The transaction will result in a non-recurring gain to Grubb & Ellis due to extinguishment of debt of about $2 million, said the real estate concern.
Grubb & Ellis said it is negotiating for a bank line of credit for general corporate purposes and acquisitions.
